model: Gemini 3.8 Flash High (serving identity hidden/unverified per contract)

environment.database: Owned disposable loopback cluster (port 54340); random per-test databases

assertions: PostgreSQL schema migration version 2 appends scheduler_control singleton row without modifying schema V1 or reseeding workspaces
V1->V2 migration fixture verifies all business records (workspaces, equipment, sessions, requests, loans, tasks, events, idempotency) and exact strings survive intact
Read-only check_schema() verifies exact schema version 2; refuses unmigrated (v0), legacy (v1), or future (v3) schemas without mutating the database
HostedSchedulerService is independently callable; does not start HTTP server, does not construct TaskRunner, does not call inference providers
Smallest durable state: singleton scheduler_control table tracks active run ID, start, lease deadline, last outcome/completion, last success, and aggregate counts
Read status function is strictly read-only: does not run tasks, carries no secrets, credentials, tokens, database URLs, session IDs, borrower text, or entity IDs
Admission and finalization are short atomic transactions; no database transaction spans the full tick
Concurrent tick execution admits one run at a time; competing instances receive 'busy' outcome under an active unexpired lease
Monotonic processing budget (20s) stops beginning new candidates; in-flight transaction completes safely; returns 'partial' outcome
Finite execution bound proven: 20s monotonic budget + 15s candidate transaction timeout + 10s finalization timeout <= 45s total worst-case bound
Outcome semantics enforced: complete uncontended tick is 'success'; contention, stopped_early, or capacity_limited (>= 100) is 'partial'; error is 'failed'
Expired 60s lease can be superseded by a new run; stale tokens cannot overwrite newer run evidence or completions
Freshness warning threshold (30 minutes of DB time) reports stale_warning=True while keeping last outcome visible
Persistence failure on evidence recording raises RuntimeError and refuses to report durable success to caller
Human borrower actions (pickup/return) racing with discovered tasks safely prevent duplicate notices or state conflicts
limits: Locally verified hosted task scheduler foundation against disposable local PostgreSQL cluster
HTTP endpoint (/api/internal/tasks/tick), Bearer authentication, and GitHub Actions cron workflow are deferred to future tasks per contract
Assistant and autonomous background runner remain disabled; zero model inference calls executed
